description:
LANDED c3e27143d on wt/kdt-close (PR #110, draft), 2026-09-03. From the
fz-kdt.144 cold review (the largest finding of the arc close). Research with
prototype, cold review (approve-with-fixes, four fixes folded), adversarial
refutation (land-with-fix, folded).

THE CHANGE: a construction wrapper's member selection is a dispatch like any
other. callsite_dispatch.rs dispatch_from_callable_flow_edges built PatternRows
straight from flow.first_class_edges in interner order and called neither
fz-kdt.143's drop nor fz-kdt.129/131's covering seat -- a wrapper's member
selection was the one dispatch in the compiler that ran neither. It is deleted;
construction_member_selection routes the members through routable_alternatives
(now taking surfaces + a same-callee predicate: an alternative is a surface and
a callee) and returns { members, plan }. jobs/transport.rs builds the member
list FROM the seated members, so the fz-kdt.108 weld (row i == member i) is a
data dependency, not an assumption. same_callee is `|_,_| true` and that is the
TRUTH of the seam, not a shortcut: runtime_demand.rs:3170
callable_flow_resolution_edges_product mints every edge of one wrapper from ONE
producer.function + ONE capture_tys (TransportOrigin::CallableValue carries one
function + one captures), so within a wrapper every member is a specialization
of one body at one layout and the drop routes narrow ⊆ wide to the same
function -- sound exactly as fz-kdt.143's callsite drop. The refuter confirmed
the named counterexamples (callable_union_capture_containment, same_lambda_two_
capture_types, 00197) are SEPARATE homogeneous wrappers, output byte-identical
three doors.

WHAT IT PROVED: the dynamic tripwire FZ_STRESS_ASSERT_SURFACE_MEMBERSHIP=1 on
00277 reads 12 surface-membership escapes at settled and under arms:6 /
arms:reverse; the routed selection takes it to 0 at all three, and stays 0
under every wrappers: seed. Two new probes: a wrapper whose members strictly
contain one another reorders [1,0] with the weld intact (the seat half, which
no corpus program forces); three nested members [int] ⊂ [int|:a] ⊂ [int|:a|:b]
collapse to one, plan None (the drop-to-one path). A source-level drop-to-one
.fz is NOT constructible and NOT owed: every list-recursive wrapper carries a
separated empty-list base member that survives, so the corpus floor is two
members; the unit probe covers the members.len()==1 path.

RIP-OUT (fz-kdt.196 step 1 folded): dispatch_from_callable_flow_edges and its
hand-rolled PatternRow (a verbatim copy of dispatch_row); routable_alternatives
/ unroutable_alternatives / stands_in_for's dependence on CallTargetSummary;
the positional zip that WAS the assumed weld; the seat gate
compiler2_dispatch_seats_the_covering_arm_where_one_covers with
SELECTION_SEAT_ALLOWANCE; BLIND_ESCAPE_POPULATION, BLIND_ESCAPE_PAIRS_ARRIVAL_
KEPT, BLIND_ESCAPE_PAIRS_BY_ARM_ORDER; dead helpers covers and labelled. The
blind-escape gate is rewritten to ASSERT EMPTINESS (reachable + six arm seeds),
proven non-vacuous by injection: bypassing the drop/seat and rebuilding makes
both it and the no-value-reaches gate FAIL and returns the tripwire to 12.
SURFACE_MEMBERSHIP_CENSUS is kept as an all-zero ratchet (196 step 4).
INDISTINGUISHABLE_ARM_POPULATION is kept at 44 groups (16/16/12), attribution
corrected to all fz-kdt.107's (a value reaches every member, so no runtime
question separates them and ordering them would be a miscompile).

MEASURED (604 fixtures, against 343f3a134): interp 0 behaviour movers, run 0
(the two normalised-away false movers are the base binary's embedded source
path in a backtrace); canon 5 movers, ALL PURE DROPS (00277, 00420, 00421_
reduce_cont_clause, enum_hof_three_distinct_closures, enum_take_drop_split:
member counts fall 4->3 / 5->3 / 3->2, zero added, zero reorders, every plan
kept); executables unchanged (the dropped member's executable stays compiled --
fz-kdt.208); three doors byte-identical and AOT base==head on the drop
fixtures; native AOT sheds the dropped body (00420 -4,832 B, 00277 -5,024 B);
FIFO/LIFO 2 = 2 (dead_closure_capture_empty_list, with_index_users_keep_nested_
list_elements); stress wrappers:1 19 = 19, arms:reverse 0 (group reversal is
now the identity, as the doc predicts). Docs rewritten to present-tense fact:
dispatch-matrix.md census table was STALE at base (entry 144->153, seat 45->29
now 0, groups 105->47 now 44, total 281->261) and is corrected;
runtime_demand.rs and callsite_dispatch.rs carry the one-callee-one-layout
soundness fact.

RESIDUES, EACH OWNED: fz-kdt.196 (steps 2-4, the rest of the census retirement)
is unblocked; fz-kdt.208 (a dropped member's executable and boundary still
published -- native DCEs it, canon keeps it); fz-kdt.131 (its enum_predicate_
search reproducer retired at 183; the proto's wrapper_members_that_overlap_
without_containment_keep_arrival_order is its wrapper-axis witness, but a
source reproducer is still owed); fz-kdt.193 (dump wN still differs from census
wN; INDISTINGUISHABLE names census numbers); fz-kdt.194 (the separated-pair tie
-break); fz-kdt.187 (the tripwire's plan-site naming and Region::List reading).
Pre-existing: 00424 panics at artifact.rs:155 (fz-kdt.149); the panic banner's
thread-id, a backtrace's addresses, and a base binary's embedded source path
are all false-mover sources any stderr md5 diff must normalise.

GATE: Coordinator gate on the folded commit (marker COORD-GATE-1788451246): fmt clean, zero build warnings, clippy clean, doctests clean, lib 1703 passed / 0 failed / 5 ignored, fixture matrix single-threaded 506 passed / 0 failed / 9 ignored; the refuter fix (one stale doc sentence) folded.

comments.text: REPRODUCER IS LIVE AND PINNED (fz-kdt.144, 0889c0b3a): FZ_STRESS_ASSERT_SURFACE_MEMBERSHIP=1 fz2 interp fixtures2/00277_enum_tier0_fixture.fz 2>&1 >/dev/null | grep -c 'surface-membership escape' -> 12. Each report names the value and the element that broke it: `value [1, :tail], element 1 = :tail is outside every clause the surface names` (4x), and the same for [3, 1, :tail] (element 2) and [5, 3, 1, :tail] (element 3). Measured invariance: 12 at the settled arrival and under arms:reverse and arms:1..6 -- the callsite arrival order does not touch it, the evidence that this is member SELECTION and not a callsite seat; 0 under wrappers:1, wrappers:6 and wrappers:reverse: the settled wrapper order is the only escaping order. Corpus-wide nothing else at the settled arrival. SURFACE_MEMBERSHIP_CENSUS pins all five rows (settled 12, arms:6 12, three wrapper settings 0), so the cure is red-first by construction: routing wrapper members through routable_alternatives must take the settled 12 to 0 without moving the wrapper rows off 0. Expect canon movers on 00277 -- classify them; 0 behaviour movers on three doors is the other half. Sequence after fz-kdt.178 (the widened static census is the second oracle).

CORRECTION from the fz-kdt.178 cold review (2026-09-03): the escaping wrappers on 00277 are w10, w11, w20 (4 members) and w13-w19 (11 members) -- TEN wrappers, 62 static covering-seat findings -- not w2, which holds s1 = [] / [{any,any}] / [] | [{any,any}] and escapes nowhere. The dynamic tripwire prints no wrapper id (value + element + predicate only), so "w2" was an inference never measured; its 12 escapes carry the test `lists {Empty, NonEmpty}, heads [ints cofinite]`, matching the [int] / [] | [int] members at those ten wrappers. Of the 62 static findings, 28 are pairs whose tests are DISJOINT at subject 0 (no value can satisfy both arms; covers's position-wise `all` reports them anyway -> fz-kdt.186), so this ticket's reachable reproducer is 34 seats across those wrappers plus 00420 4, enum_take_drop_split 4, enum_hof_three_distinct_closures 3 on the corpus. fz-kdt.178 lands a per-SITE allowance in the seat gate; this ticket retires it row by row. Also measured: selection findings are invariant under every arm seed (this is a wrapper-order axis), the fz-kdt.108 weld (outcomes[i].body_id == i) holds on every wrapper in the corpus, and the seated order IS the member-list order by construction -- so routing members through routable_alternatives must re-derive the weld from the seated order, exactly as the ticket says.

DATA POINT from the fz-kdt.183 cold review (2026-09-03): keying recursive activations on the list ELEMENT (183's prototype) retires this ticket's dynamic reproducer entirely -- 00277 surface-membership escapes 12 -> 0 at settled and under arms:6, enum_predicate_search 1 -> 0 -- because the members that used to differ only in a tail no test reads become distinct elements the test CAN read. That does not make member selection sound (the seat and drop still never run on it: a wrapper whose members differ elsewhere still seats by mint order), so this ticket stays; but its acceptance oracle changes with 183/124 and the reachable reproducer set must be re-measured after they land.

YOUR REPRODUCER IS NOW A STATIC GATE, PER SITE (fz-kdt.178, 8de517a28). SELECTION_SEAT_ALLOWANCE in drive_test.rs holds 21 rows / 73 findings: 00277 w10 2, w11 2, w13-w19 8 each, w20 2 (62), enum_hof_three_distinct_closures w3/w4/w5 1 each (3), and 00420_enum_take_drop_split + behavior/enum_take_drop_split w21-w24 1 each (8). 28 of the 73 are fz-kdt.186's, not yours -- 00277 w13-w19, four apiece, marked UNREACHABLE-PAIR in the failure text -- so land 186 first and your target is 45. BLIND_ESCAPE_POPULATION names the same sites (45 reachable readings) and INDISTINGUISHABLE_ARM_POPULATION carries 105 one-question groups across 00277 (47), enum_map_family (46) and 00420 (12), all wrapper selections. The body's "w2" is wrong and was never measured: w2's members are [], [{any,any}] and their union -- no int, escapes nowhere. Acceptance now has three oracles: the dynamic tripwire (12 -> 0 on 00277), the seat allowance (rows to zero one by one), and the twins ratchet (a drop that runs on member selection dissolves what it can).

fz-kdt.183 rule review (2026-09-03): under the rule your dynamic reproducer (enum_predicate_search under arms:6) reads 0 and the selection seat findings fall 73 -> 29 (after 186: 45 -> ?): the members that differed only in a tail no test reads now differ in a key the seat CAN read. Member selection still never runs the drop or the seat (this ticket's subject); re-measure the reachable population after 186 and 183 land, in that order.

fz-kdt.186 landed (accb5cfbe): your reproducer is now 45 reachable selection seat findings, not 62/73. SELECTION_SEAT_ALLOWANCE reads 00277 w10 2, w11 2, w13-w19 4 each, w20 2 (34 total), enum_hof_three_distinct_closures 3, 00420_enum_take_drop_split 4, behavior/enum_take_drop_split 4. Every row now routes a value; the 28 that did not are gone from both readers, not re-blessed. (fz-kdt.183 then retires more: re-measure after both land, in that order.)

fz-kdt.183 landed (2e0bb2706): SELECTION_SEAT_ALLOWANCE 21 sites/27 readings -> 17/29. 00277 w13/w14/w16/w17 retire; w15/w18/w19 go 2 -> 4. No new site; every reading is still a member whose covering sibling exists and is seated second. Re-measure from this base.

title: Construction-wrapper member selection bypasses the drop and the covering seat: dispatch_from_callable_flow_edges seats members in interner order
